fato_historico: 1920: Qantas, Australia's national airline, is founded as Queensland and Northern Territory Aerial Services Limited.

Perhaps the universe is inviting you to take flight toward long-held aspirations. Stay grounded yet open to the winds of change blowing softly your way.
frase_do_dia: Spread your wings wide and trust the gentle currents of your beautiful destiny.
